# id: # Strength: quest rewards plus the melee rows from the Attack table (the attack style picks the skill).

name: Scorpion Catcher
note: Rewards 6,625 Strength as a one-off; needs Prayer 31 and Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl; must be able to run past level 172 black demons and level 64 poison spiders.

name: Dragon Slayer I
note: Rewards 18,650 Strength and 18,650 Defence as a one-off; needs 32 quest points (not a skill); Elvarg (83) is among the enemies; unlocks Slayer dragon tasks.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Waterfall Quest
note: No requirements; rewards 13,750 Attack and 13,750 Strength as a one-off, so no hourly rate is given; must evade level 86 Fire Giants and level 84 Moss Guardian, level 17 Hitpoints recommended.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Gemstone Crab
note: Effectively infinite Hitpoints, 87.5% xp per hit but no overkill waste; crab relocates every 10 minutes and up to 16 players benefit; no xp/hr given.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Ammonite Crabs
note: Highest-Hitpoints crab per the UIM guide; aggressive for 10 minutes; drops fossils; Bone Voyage needed for Fossil Island; the Ironman guide says xp is slightly lower than gemstone crabs; no xp/hr given.
source: OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee; Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Nightmare Zone
note: Ironman guide gives about 70,000 xp/hr with mid-game ironman gear at base 70 melee (up to 85,000 on the boss list); pay-to-play page gives no rate; dreams cost a coin fee; absorption potions used for the normal rumble.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Sulphur Naguas
note: Pay-to-play summary gives 75k xp/hr at 60 Strength and 130k at 75 Strength with full Blood Moon set and Piety; Ironman guide says 140k with Piety, 110k without; moonlight potions need no other supplies; dual macuahuitl needs 70 Attack and 75 Strength per the Ironman guide.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Melee training; Ironman Guide/Melee 2026-11-11

name: Scurrius
note: Pay-to-play guide says "100k+" xp/hr soloing the group variant with a bone mace at base-70 combat stats (the 100000 here is a lower bound); needs 40 Prayer; drops only cover supplies.

name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
note: Needs partial Monkey Madness II and Hallowfell (75 Attack); pay-to-play guide gives "200k xp/hr or more" with good stacking and crystal halberd specials, up to 300k with very strong strength gear.

name: Gargoyles
note: Needs 75 Slayer, a rock hammer and Priest in Peril; Guthan's equipment recommended; wiki gives no xp/hr and says the xp rate is substantially lower than other options; earnings upwards of 700k gp/hr.
